plan.failureSummary: Page AI used a stale cached selector that clicked the 'Solutions' dropdown instead of 'Developers', navigating to '/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/' and failing the URL assertion.
observedIndicators: Deterministic mode used cached selectors that targeted the 'Solutions' navigation button instead of 'Developers'
The page navigated to 'https://www.checklyhq.com/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/' causing expect(page.url()).toEqual('https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/') to fail
assertionsFailedAfterSuccessfulPageAi is true while usedDeterministicMode is true and isRetryAttempt is false
Flow history indicates 100% pass rate across prior deterministic runs before the site structure update

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page AI cache and retry test execution
remediationSteps.details: Re-run the test with 'clearPageAiCache' enabled to force page.ai to discover the updated 'Developers' menu element autonomously.

remediationSteps.summary: Validate navigation bar locators if retry fails
remediationSteps.details: If cache invalidation does not resolve the issue, verify if the top navigation DOM structure on checklyhq.com requires explicit selector adjustments in custom flows.

plan.notes: In deterministic execution mode, page.ai used cached selectors (#nav > nav > ... > div:nth-of-type(2) > button) which matched the 'Solutions' button instead of the 'Developers' button due to navigation layout changes on checklyhq.com. Consequently, clicking the dropdown item navigated to the Solutions page rather than Documentation (/docs/). The natural language instruction 'Click on the Developers dropdown menu, then click into to the Documentation option' is semantically flexible, so invalidating the Page AI cache will allow the autonomous agent to relocate the correct 'Developers' menu item and pass.
